quickStart.title: Get started with GuardMCP-KR
quickStart.desc: Register an MCP server with the three steps below and the gateway home fills in with your server inventory and security events.

step1.title: Point the MCP endpoint at the gateway
step1.desc: From then on every tool call is inspected.

step2.title: Choose policy packs
step2.desc: Enable the packs matching the threats you care about. You can change this any time from the Policies screen.

step3.title: Run the demo
step3.desc: Pick an attack scenario and compare the unguarded and guarded runs side by side in under three minutes.

log.title: Log
log.storeRawHint: By default, logs and events store only masked copies.

failOpenDialog.title: Risk notice
failOpenDialog.body: With fail-open, tool calls keep going through even while the gateway is down, and you will have to decide on each threat yourself as it is found. Continue?

storeRawDialog.title: Turn on raw storage?
storeRawDialog.body: Turning this on stores the raw text of detected PII and credentials, encrypted, in a separate table. Only authorized users can reveal it, and every reveal is recorded in the audit log. This setting is separate from your organization's data retention and privacy policies — responsibility for the storage itself rests with the operator.
